pr_body:
Enable logsdb by default if `logsdb.prior_logs_usage` has not been set to true.

Meaning that if no data streams were created matching with the logs-*-* pattern in 8.x, then logsdb will be enabled by default for data streams matching with `logs-*-*` pattern.

Also removes `LogsPatternUsageService` as with version 9.0 and beyond, this component is no longer necessary.

Followup from #120708
Closes #106489

issue_context.title: Enable LogsDB by default for `logs-*-*` for stateful deployments
issue_context.body:
### Description

We will introduce the [new index.mode "logs" as a tech preview](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/106462) in Elasticsearch 8.15. As a result, while in tech preview, the choice of adopting the new index mode is up to integrations.

After we decide which Elasticsearch version will introduce LogsDB as Generally Available the new index mode we need, anyway, to apply the new index mode "logs" by default to all `logs-*-*` index templates.
comments:
> the choice of adopting the new index mode is up to integrations.

As long as the logsdb mode is in tech preview, I don't think integrations can adopt it especially as long as not all fields are supported because otherwise it could be a breaking change for our users. What we can do is start testing / benchmarking with logsdb.

review_comments: I'm on the fence about deleting this, since `8.x` will continue to receive updates for a while - it's easier to have the same code in `8.x`, `9.x` and `main` as much as possible.. Maybe wrap this in a cluster setting with the default flipped in `9.x` and `main`?

This component should never be enabled in 9.0 and onwards. If it is accidentally enabled, then it can cause logsdb to not be enabled at all by default in 9.x. So I think it best just to delete this code.

I also think that the component itself shouldn't get any changes, except for bug fixes.
